description: Live bug: checking 'Safehold' surfaced compilation listings that spell out several already-owned book titles by name instead of using a 'Books 1-3'/'Boxed Set'/'Omnibus'/'Series, Volume' label (which discovery_engine.looks_like_non_new_release already catches on its own -- that deterministic-layer check is a separate, unit-level guard). This is the series_agent-level backstop for a differently-worded compilation that has no bundle keyword at all, just several owned titles strung together, so it had no parseable number and no bundle keyword and slipped through as a new 'available' book. Frozen from tests/test_series_discovery.py::SeriesCheckIntegrationTest::test_compilation_listing_naming_multiple_owned_titles_is_rejected.

candidates.title: David Weber Reader's Companion: Off Armageddon Reef and By Schism Rent Asunder
